GENERAL HEADQUARTERS
SUPREME COMMANDER FOR THE ALLIED POWERS
AG 000.5 (12 May 47) LS-R
(SCAPIN - 1666)
APO 500
12 May 1947
MEMORANDUM FOR : IMPERIAL JAPANESE GOVERNMENT.
THROUGH : Central Liaison Office, Tokyo.
SUBJECT : Apprehension of Suspected War Criminals.
The following named Japanese will be apprehended as Suspected War Criminals and delivered to the Commanding General, EIGHTH Army, at Sugamo Prison (Tokyo Detention Camp), at the earliest possible date.
NAME RANK OR TITLE PERTINENT DATA
HAMADA, Sukeo Sgt/Maj Kempei Tai. Transferred from 106 Base Hospital Rangoon, Burma, 25 Dec 44. Believed to live on Shikoku Island.
KIMURA Tsutau (Tsutofu) Civ Was in Labor Section Nittetsu Mines, Futase, using POWs from Fukuoka #10 Camp, 20 May 43 -21 Sep 45. Probable Home Address: Iizuka City, Fukuoka Prefecture.
MORI Seiji Civilian Employee. Japanese Consulate Singora Mitsubishi Shoji, Singora Naval Landing Force Singora and Penang. Singora, Oct 41 - Feb 42. Penang, Feb 42.
SHIBATA, Shigeo Maj Medical Corps, Medical Dent, 2nd Army, New Guinea, Dec 43 until after the war. Probable Home Address: Nagasaki-ken, Kitamatsuura-gun, Shinmikuriya-machi, Osaki, Nishidamen 824.
FOR THE SUPREME COMMANDER:
R.M. LEVY,
Colonel, AGD,
Adjutant General.
